title: Burn marks on the northeast side of the Colossi of Memnon

tellings.quote: stone statues in the world called the colassi of mnon and they have burn marks only on the northeast side

plain: The Colossi of Memnon, a pair of huge ancient stone statues in Egypt, have burn marks only on their northeast side, according to a researcher named Matt LaCroix. He tells Michels this, without naming a source, on an episode about something he says happened around 12,000 BC, and he presents the one-sided marks as a sign of some event that came from a single direction.
